findings.description: The source bowl visibly holds only green olives, yet dark purple/black olives appear in the jar from 00:00.5 onward (a dark olive is already at the jar bottom before any dark olive is seen in or leaving the bowl); by 00:01.75 roughly half the jar's olives are dark. findings.description: A small hand-held bowl holding roughly 6-8 olives yields ~25 olives in the jar by 00:03 while the bowl still appears to contain olives; the amount arriving far exceeds what the source could hold.

The bowl is loaded at 00:05.0-00:05.75 with green olives scooped from the steel bowl, which contained only green olives, but by 00:06.75-00:07.25 it contains dark purple olives that are then poured into the jar. No dark-olive source was used.

findings.description: The jar grows from ~25 olives (00:05.75) to ~40+ olives (00:09.5) from a single small bowl of roughly 8 olives; the increase exceeds what the source held.

After olives are scooped at 00:05.0, brown pit/nut-like objects appear in the steel bowl at 00:05.25 that were not visible before (it held only green olives at 00:04.75). They could have been hidden under olives, so confidence is limited.
